decisions.reason: The current SPS30 connector pinout already specifies SEL→GND and I2C signal lines, so the source clarification does not require a state change.
SPS30 mode selection through SEL does not change the requirement's logic-voltage compatibility or level-shifter policy.
The SPS30 SEL connection and I2C operating mode do not affect main-board panel controls or inputs.
Hardwiring the SPS30 SEL pin does not alter the sensor board's mechanical placement, orientation, or enclosure constraints.
The source decision concerns the SPS30 module-side SEL wiring and does not change the main-board connector inventory.
Selecting SPS30 I2C mode does not change standalone USB power capacity, source selection, or powered scope.
The SPS30 SEL wiring is unrelated to the addressable LED supply and data-level handling.
The SPS30 remains a switched 5V load; its SEL-controlled communication mode does not change boost-enable behavior or load membership.
The SPS30 communication-mode selection does not alter main-board 3.3V source OR-ing.
Hardwiring SPS30 SEL to GND does not change which rails are monitored or the current-monitor placement and coverage.
The SPS30 I2C-mode decision has no effect on the battery connector, pinout, voltage range, or AXP2101 connection.
The SPS30 SEL connection does not change main-board dimensions, connector placement, orientation, or enclosure layout.
